text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp drew to a close 
in a flash... and the day to return to the 
academy arrived.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ah! Trainer, the bus has started boarding!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Let's go! Where's my seat? I wonder if 
it's close to my friends~

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Also, I'd be really happy with a 
sunny seat~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we boarded the bus and headed for 
Tracen Academy—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Mmm! It's the usual Trainer's office...!
choice_data_list:
You must be exhausted, you could've just 
gone back to the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. It's just, even though not that 
much time has passed, I somehow started 
feeling nostalgic.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, please don't mind me! You have luggage 
to unpack and organize too, right, 
Trainer-san?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Just soaking in the... atmosphere? Yeah, 
once I've had my fill of the vibes, I'll 
head back whenever~.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Fufu, please don't mind me~. Phew—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (Mm... huh?)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (Ah. ...Here it comes—)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —Ah.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (I get it...! I understand, somehow!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: This way...!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*... Heheh!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (This way... I'm sure it's this way!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Cesario. Messiah-san. Heart-san. 
Everyone's dreams. Everyone's futures. 
Everyone's bonds.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (And surely, over here—!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, phew...!! Umm—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Found itâ!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(There... There she is! I finally found 
her! —*Myself*!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ah... huh?

text_block_list.name: "Me"
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so?

text_block_list.name: "Me"
text_block_list.text: Only me.

text_block_list.name: "Me"
text_block_list.text: There's only me here.

text_block_list.name: "Me"
text_block_list.text:
"...There's no one here, you know? 
Nobody."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Huh—?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Click*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I stood up from my desk and stretched 
a bit. I only meant to organize the 
training camp records, but it ended up 
taking much longer than expected."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking we have tomorrow ahead of us and 
should head home soon... I glance at the 
sofa and freeze in shock.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I called out to her and shook her 
shoulders a few times, but... she still 
won't wake up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, maybe today's fatigue from the 
training camp caught up to her. She looked 
like she was trying really hard, so it 
makes sense that she fell asleep.
choice_data_list:
(The test results came back normal, too, 
so...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I'll try to convince her and take 
her to the clinic next time. Thinking 
that, I carried the soundly sleeping Rhein 
Kraft on my back.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah, good evening! Good work today... Whoa, 
you really fell asleep again.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Well, either way, all I'm doing for the 
rest of today is sleeping, but... hmm.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm sorry! I'll take them right away. 
I'll guide them from here.
choice_data_list: Thank you, Cesario. That really helps.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho, and... there.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Amazing, they're completely out cold.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...You must be hungry, so when you wake 
up, let's go make a late-night snack 
together again, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Feel free to wake me up even in the 
middle of the night. ...I'll leave a note 
by your pillow, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Good night, Craft.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Oh, Messiah. Morning!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Heart-san. Are you heading 
to breakfast now?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
For someone who usually wakes up early, 
this is rather late for you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Don't say it~. I was so exhausted 
after the training camp that I ended up 
oversleeping.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
My roommate is usually a way heavier 
sleeper than me, so this morning she was 
totally giddy, saying, "For once, I get to 
wake you up!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
The way I got woken up was so wild it 
freaked me out. Care to hear the details?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
No... it feels a bit creepy, so I'll pass. 
...Speaking of running late, though.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Heart-san aside, I didn't see Cesario-san 
or the others in the cafeteria either—"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: S-Someone...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Th-That just now was—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: That's Cesario's voice!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Cesario?! What was that loud shout just 
now—?!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Ah... ah, Heart-san—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
P-Please, Dorm Leader...! No, an 
ambulance! We have to call one, right 
away...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
What?! Wh-Whoa, wait a second! Calm down, 
an ambulance, you say!?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Because Craft! Craft won't wake up...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Craft-san did...? ...No, but 
Cesario-san—"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
She seems to be breathing fine... As far 
as I can tell, isn't she just asleep...?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: No, something is wrong!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
In the first place, Craft fell asleep in 
the Trainer's room yesterday, and her 
Trainer and I had to carry her all the way 
to her dorm bed, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"And she hasn't woken up since! Even when 
I call out to her, she won't open her 
eyes!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: She's not waking up at all...!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
—I'm sorry, it seems I took the situation 
a bit too lightly.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Cesario-san, please call for emergency 
services immediately. I will go get 
Heart-san and her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Paramedic
text_block_list.text:
Stretcher over here! Hurry! ...Hm, are you 
her dedicated trainer?

text_block_list.name: Paramedic
text_block_list.text:
Then please come along with us! The 
nearest hospital is ready to admit her, so 
we'll head over immediately. ...Hurry!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Upon arriving at the hospital, 
examinations were carried out immediately. 
Even more thorough and comprehensive than 
the ones we requested on the first day of 
the training camp—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"However, the result was the same. 'No 
abnormalities found.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Rhein Kraft is fast asleep. Her body 
rises and falls smoothly with each breath. 
The sighs slipping past her lips are quiet 
and peaceful."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As always, a cherry-blossom blush painted 
her cheeks. Her soft, dazed expression was 
just like how she looked whenever she was 
sunbathing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bask in plenty of sunlight, feel good, and 
take a sound afternoon nap.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like something she would do. 
Oversleeping a little bit is totally in 
character for a gentle, easygoing girl 
like Rhein Kraft.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Soon, surely.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying "Good morning~" in that gentle, 
airy voice of hers, any second now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Any moment now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It looked as if she were about to say 
it right now.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: —Ah! Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Have you been here all night?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: And so, ...what about Craft?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She tries to say something. ...But it 
doesn't form into words, and she simply 
shakes her head.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She looked as if she were merely sleeping. 
As if she might wake up at any second.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, Rhein Kraft never, ever opened 
her eyes.
